title: Darwin vs Vishnu: Why Dasavatara is NOT Evolution
tags: Similarity between Lord Vishnu's Dashavatar and Charles Darwin's Theory of Evolution
10 Avatars of Vishnu and Darwin's Theory of Evolution
description:
Can the Dasavatara, the ten incarnations of Vishnu in Hindu mythology, really be compared to Darwinian evolution? Some claim that ancient rishis already knew what Darwin discovered centuries later, but this is just pseudoscience in disguise. In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts examines the supposed parallels between Dasavatara and evolution, and explains why the comparison falls apart.

From Matsya the fish to Kurma the tortoise, Varaha the boar, Narasimha the man-lion, and later human avatars like Vamana and Parasurama, we explore how these mythological stories are symbolic tales—not scientific theories. Evolution is not about gods putting on costumes or direction-driven plans, but about random mutation, natural selection, and speciation over billions of years.

We highlight flaws such as: fish not being the first life form, tortoises not being amphibians, Narasimha being anti-evolutionary (no half-human half-animal exists), and the avatars shifting from biological to social/occupational changes rather than evolutionary ones. Religious texts like the Bhagavata Purana and Dasam Granth even disagree on the list of avatars, unlike the scientific consensus on evolution.

If you’ve searched for Dasavatara and Darwinian evolution, Hinduism and science, Vishnu’s avatars explained, evolution debunked myths, or religion vs science, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!

Chapters
00:00 – Introduction: Dasavatara vs Darwin’s evolution claims
02:20 – What is Darwinian evolution? The science explained
05:10 – No consensus on Dasavatara lists across sects
08:00 – Matsya the fish and the flood myth problem
11:00 – Kurma the tortoise vs amphibians in evolution
14:20 – Varaha, Narasimha, and anti-evolutionary avatars
18:10 – Vamana, Parasurama, and the shift to social changes
22:00 – Why Dasavatara ≠ Darwinian evolution
25:00 – Conclusion: Myths, pseudoscience, and the need for critical thinking

Why do all religions have a flood theory where the land was submerged once?
Ancient people would have consistently observed oceanic animals' fossils in mountain ranges, deserts, and places where the land is far away from oceans. For eg: in India, ancient people would have seen whale fossils in the foothills of the Himalayas. At that time the best explanation for such observation is the land/earth submerge theory. So ancient people took this theory into their mythologies. But today we know it's because of plate tectonics and there is no way that earth can be submerged into oceans.
